Title: 487583-2026: Italy – Architectural, construction and engineering services and inspection services – CONNECTIONS AND INTERACTIONS FOR THE WATERFRONT OF PALERMO - DESIGN COMPETITION FOR AN AERIAL CONNECTION SYSTEM BETWEEN THE PORT AND THE CITY CUP D79J21017830001
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Design competition for an aerial connection system between the port and the city in Palermo suggests a pedestrian / cable or suspension bridge or an exceptional structural solution, therefore very relevant for sbp (architectural and structural services tendered). Location in Italy and lack of details on spans / technical execution slightly reduce the priority.
titel: Design competition for an aerial connection system between the port and the city in Palermo
kurzbeschreibung: Design competition for an elevated connection between the port and the city on the Palermo waterfront.
umfang: Design competition for a system of elevated or aerial connection between the port and the city in the area of the Palermo waterfront; specific technical parameters, spans, dimensions, routing or type of structure are not stated in the notice.
leistungen: Architectural, construction and engineering services within the framework of a design competition; subsequent service contracts are to be awarded to one of the competition winners.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Early strategic entry opportunity via a design competition with a potential follow-up contract.
• In terms of content, the tender indicates a special structure or bridge / connection construction in an urban port environment.
• Very good fit for sbp for lightweight, innovative and architecturally sophisticated connection structures.
• Waterfront and port context may imply high architectural and structural requirements.
• Relevance is somewhat reduced because no technical parameters, spans or specific structural type are stated.
• Award criteria are only generally described as quality; detailed assessment requires the procurement documents.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs are stated in the notice. A reliable estimate is not possible due to the lack of key information such as type of structure, length, spans, number of supports, access elements, materials and integration into the existing context. Based on the title, an infrastructural special structure in the waterfront area can be assumed, potentially in the multi-million to double-digit million range, but not realistically quantifiable.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee is stated in the notice. As this is a design competition with a possible follow-up contract, a fee could in principle be derived from construction costs and scope of services; however, reliable information on scope, service phases and costs is lacking.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Eligibility criteria according to the procurement documents; not specified in detail in the TED notice itself.
zuschlagskriterien: Quality; further details according to the procurement documents or competition regulations.
auftraggeber: Autorità di Sistema Portuale del Mare di Sicilia Occidentale, Via piano dell'ucciardone 4, 90139 Palermo, Italy, E-Mail: info@pec.portpalermo.it, Website: www.adsppalermo.it
notes: Amendment notice to a previous publication; extension of deadline and amended procurement documents. Additional information until 30.07.2026, 12:00. Submission electronically via https://piattaforma.concorsidiprogettazione.it. Procedure language Italian.
